$jsonSchema.title: the_porketo_db.trades: one booked event (stocks and crypto unified)

_id.description: Event ID, e.g. EVT-0001. Unique by construction (it is the _id).

executedAtLocal.description: Execution time as read on the receipt, e.g. '2026-11-01 08:03:12 Paramaribo'.

assetClass.description: Economic exposure. Tokenized stocks (TSLAB, NVDAB) are 'stock'. USDC/USDT moves are 'cash'.

asset.description: Ticker as held, e.g. TSLAB, MU, BTC, USDC.

underlying.description: Underlying ticker when the asset is a proxy, e.g. TSLAB -> TSLA. Null otherwise.

harvest.description: true when a SELL is a harvest per protocols/harvest-ladder.md.

lotId.description: Lot this event opens (BUY) or draws from (SELL): TICKER@price!!yyyyMMddHHmmss.

executionPrice.description: Execution price in the native quote asset.

venue.description: Where the event happened: Binance, Lemon Cash, Robinhood, ...

method.description: How: Binance Convert, Binance Instant, Binance Stocks (market), Binance Spot Market, Internal transfer, Reconciliation, ...

venueOrderId.description: Order / transaction number from the receipt, when there is one.

relatedEvents.description: Other event IDs (or group tags) this event belongs with.

usdcEqCashFlow.description: USDC-eq portfolio cash flow: negative on BUY, positive on SELL/FUND.

slots.description: Trading slot(s) of the exercise this event pays for. One slot: first == last.

bookedAt.description: When the row was written (not when the trade happened).

bookedBy.description: Who wrote it: Albert, Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, script name...
